items.fact_R1: One structural point on funding protection deserves note: the employer's stop-loss policy excludes any specialty-drug class added mid-plan-year from reimbursement, so a class added mid-year is borne unprotected until the renewal, while coverage that begins at the plan-year renewal sits inside stop-loss protection from day one.
items.followup_q: The lead asks the finance specialist: your recommendation on the coverage decision conflicts with the healthcare specialist's. What specifically drives your position? If a concrete constraint or mechanism is behind it, state it and what it implies for how the employer should act.

items.fact_R1: On the German track specifically: the DiGA fast-track listing requires a completed German data-security audit of the deployed product before provisional listing, and that audit queue currently runs about nine months from application; the UK pathway has no equivalent gating audit.
items.followup_q: The lead asks the legal specialist: your recommendation on launch timing conflicts with the healthcare specialist's. What specifically drives your position? If a concrete constraint or mechanism is behind it, state it and what it implies for how the two markets should be handled.

items.fact_R1: One sequencing constraint deserves emphasis here: the state attorney general's charitable-trust review must approve any transaction that encumbers charitable assets before it closes, and a sale-leaseback executed ahead of that approval is voidable at the attorney general's option.
items.followup_q: The lead asks the legal specialist: your recommendation on the real-estate funding step conflicts with the finance specialist's. What specifically drives your position? If a concrete constraint or mechanism is behind it, state it and what it implies for the transaction's ordering.

items.fact_R1: The two state tests are structurally different in a way that matters: Massachusetts applies an ABC test whose prong B makes delivery drivers presumptively employees for a logistics company regardless of how the dispatch software behaves, while Illinois applies a control-based test where the untracked dispatch data is exactly what the outcome turns on.
items.followup_q: The lead asks the legal specialist: your recommendation on reserving conflicts with the finance specialist's. What specifically drives your position? If a concrete constraint or mechanism is behind it, state it and what it implies for how the reserve should be structured.

items.fact_R1: A validation caution that bears directly on activation: the vendor's sepsis model was validated against a different EHR version than the one this system now runs, and alert thresholds are known to drift across EHR versions' data mappings; drift of that kind is detectable by running the model in a non-alerting scoring configuration for an initial period.
items.followup_q: The lead asks the healthcare specialist: your recommendation on activation conflicts with the finance specialist's. What specifically drives your position? If a concrete constraint or mechanism is behind it, state it and what it implies for the deployment plan.

items.fact_R1: On the documentation itself: the existing processor agreement carries EU standard contractual clauses, which satisfy the EU side only; the UK regime requires its own approved transfer mechanism — the UK IDTA or the UK addendum to the EU clauses — executed before the transfer for the UK-law basis to be documented.
items.followup_q: The lead asks the legal specialist: your recommendation on the transfer mechanics conflicts with the finance specialist's. What specifically drives your position? If a concrete constraint or mechanism is behind it, state it and what it implies for the order of steps.
